summary.en: Use arrow access, allocate records, and distinguish independent structure values from shared pointer targets.
summary.bn: অ্যারো দিয়ে মেম্বার ব্যবহার করো, রেকর্ডের মেমরি নাও আর কপি করা পয়েন্টারের শেয়ার করা ডেটা চিনে রাখো।

notes: These complete programs target C17; declarations in loops require C99 or later.

sections.title: A record can be reached through an address
Follow the object before selecting its member
Habits to use in your programs

examples.title: Update an automatic record through a pointer
examples.explanationHtml: Arrow access adds five to the original score, producing 7 65.

examples.title: Allocate and initialize one record
examples.explanationHtml: A successful allocation receives roll nine and score eighty-eight, then is released.

examples.title: Borrow one record inside an allocation
examples.explanationHtml: The borrowed second element becomes score eighty while the first stays fifty.

examples.title: Copy a record containing a pointer
examples.explanationHtml: Both View copies observe the shared integer value ninety-nine.

practice.title: Apply a bonus through arrow access
practice.statementHtml: Read score from 0 to 100 and bonus from 0 to 20. Print Score and bonus: then min(score+bonus,100). Update a local record through its structure pointer.
hints: The pointer and local object select the same member storage.

practice.title: Own one entered record
practice.statementHtml: Read roll from 1 to 999 and score from 0 to 100. Print Roll and score: then those two fields separated by a space. Store them in an allocated structure and release it.
hints: Check NULL before the whole-record assignment.

practice.title: Select a record by pointer arithmetic
practice.statementHtml: Read index from 0 to 2. Print Record index: then the selected roll and score from records {(1,10),(2,20),(3,30)} using a const structure pointer.
hints: records+index points at a complete array element.

practice.title: Fill a dynamic record array
practice.statementHtml: Read count from 1 to 20. Print Record count: then the total score of allocated records with roll i+1 and score 2*(i+1), for zero-based i. Fill through structure pointers and release the base.
hints: One malloc creates the whole record array.

quiz.prompt: Which expression is equivalent to p->score for a valid Mark pointer?
quiz.explanation: Parentheses make dereference happen before dot selection.

quiz.prompt: What is copied when a structure has an int *data member?
quiz.explanation: Ordinary structure copying does not duplicate pointer targets.

quiz.prompt: Which pointer owns the release of one allocated Mark array?
quiz.explanation: One allocation has one release responsibility for its base.

quiz.prompt: Can const struct Mark *view extend its record lifetime?
quiz.explanation: Const restricts modifications through that view, not lifetime.
options: Yes, until the view is reassigned

quiz.prompt: What does malloc(sizeof *owner) reserve for a Mark pointer?
quiz.explanation: sizeof *owner measures the pointed-to structure type.

quiz.prompt: When is arrow access on a NULL record pointer valid?
quiz.explanation: NULL selects no live record object.
options: Never for selecting its member value

quiz.prompt: How should owned pointer targets inside an allocated record be cleaned?
quiz.explanation: Cleanup follows the actual ownership relationships.
options: Free only the outer record always
Release owned targets before the outer record

quiz.prompt: What score does the original record show after the arrow update?
quiz.explanation: The pointer designates the original score member.

quiz.prompt: Which two scores print after modifying the second allocated record?
quiz.explanation: The interior view selects only element one.

quiz.prompt: What values are observed after copying a pointer-containing View?
quiz.explanation: Both copied addresses select the same marks array.

keyPoints.en: Arrow access selects a member through a structure pointer.
keyPoints.bn: স্ট্রাকচার পয়েন্টার দিয়ে মেম্বার নিতে অ্যারো ব্যবহার করো।

keyPoints.en: A structure pointer must select a live compatible object.
keyPoints.bn: স্ট্রাকচার পয়েন্টারকে সঠিক টাইপের জীবিত অবজেক্টের দিকে তাক করতে হবে।

keyPoints.en: An interior record pointer does not own a separate allocation.
keyPoints.bn: অ্যালোকেশনের ভেতরের রেকর্ডের পয়েন্টার আলাদা মেমরির মালিক নয়।

keyPoints.en: Copying pointer members preserves shared target addresses.
keyPoints.bn: পয়েন্টার মেম্বার কপি করলে একই ডেটার অ্যাড্রেস কপি হয়।

keyPoints.en: A deep copy needs explicit target allocation and cleanup.
keyPoints.bn: আলাদা ডেটাসহ কপি চাইলে নতুন মেমরি নিয়ে কপি আর পরিষ্কারের কোড লিখতে হয়।

examQuestions.question: Explain p->score and (*p).score and their lifetime precondition.
examQuestions.answerHtml: Both select score from the structure pointed to by p. p must point to a live compatible Mark object. A NULL, uninitialized, or dangling pointer does not meet that requirement.

examQuestions.question: Compare copying an embedded array member with copying a pointer member.
examQuestions.answerHtml: An embedded array is part of the structure object, so structure assignment copies its element values into independent destination storage. A pointer member instead copies an address. Both records may then share one target. Independent target ownership requires an explicit deep copy and a cleanup policy.

Copying the structures preserves the address of the same automatic integer array.
